faq.description: Answers to common questions about the 3.0 TDV6 and SDV6 engine in the Land Rover Discovery 4. If yours is not covered, our team can help.

faqs.q: Can a Range Rover 306DT engine fit my Discovery 4?
faqs.a: Not always directly. 306DT engines differ in output, ancillaries and wiring between models, so we check your VIN, engine code and TDV6 or SDV6 specification before recommending any replacement engine.

faqs.q: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt 306DT engines compare?
faqs.a: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

faqs.q: Can I buy a Discovery 4 306DT engine supply only?
faqs.a: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

faqs.q: What affects the cost of a Discovery 4 306DT engine replacement?
faqs.a: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as turbos or a DPF, and the labour involved, including body lifting. Send your registration or VIN for a quote.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on a replacement 306DT engine?
faqs.a: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

faqs.q: Do you deliver 3.0 TDV6 engines across the UK?
faqs.a: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

faqs.q: How long does a Discovery 4 306DT engine replacement take?
faqs.a: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.

workshopIntro.title: Repair, Rebuild or Replace Your 306DT?
workshopIntro.description: The fault, mileage and value of your Discovery 4 decide the right route. Turbo, EGR, DPF and oil cooler faults can often be repaired individually. Where the crankshaft has failed or the bearings have spun, a rebuild or Land Rover Discovery 4 306DT engine replacement is usually the more sensible choice.
paragraphs: Bearing failures are often linked to oil supply, so we look beyond the engine itself. Where relevant, we inspect the oil cooler, turbos, intercooler, EGR system, DPF and cooling system, and renew the oil, filters and coolant before the engine runs.

Send your registration or VIN with a short description of the symptoms. We will confirm compatibility, explain the options and quote for supply only, supply and fit at our Grays workshop, or delivery across the UK.

engineProblems.title: Common Discovery 4 3.0 TDV6 Problems
engineProblems.description: The 306DT usually gives warning signs before major failure, so prompt checks can prevent wider damage.

cards.title: Spun Bearings and Crank Failure
cards.description: A deep knocking noise, oil pressure warnings or a sudden loss of power may indicate spun bearings or crankshaft failure, often linked to oil supply. We check oil pressure, bearings and the crankshaft.

cards.title: Front and Rear Belt Wear
cards.description: The 3.0 V6 uses a front timing belt and a rear fuel pump belt. Neglected changes can lead to belt failure and serious damage. We inspect both belts and their tensioners.

cards.title: Twin-Turbo Boost Faults
cards.description: Power loss, limp mode or boost fault codes may come from the sequential turbo system, a faulty actuator, a split hose or a worn turbocharger. We test both turbos and boost control.
cards.action: Fuel rail and injector leak-off test

cards.title: Oil Cooler and Seal Leaks
cards.description: Oil in the coolant, coolant loss or a milky residue may come from a leaking oil cooler or perished seals within the system. We check the fluids and pressure-test the system.

cards.title: EGR Valve and Cooler Faults
cards.description: Rough idle, hesitation, smoke or EGR fault codes can be caused by carbon-clogged EGR valves or a leaking EGR cooler. We test EGR operation and inspect the cooler.

cards.title: DPF Blockage on Short Trips
cards.description: Frequent regeneration attempts, DPF warnings or reduced power are common when short journeys stop the particulate filter clearing properly. We read soot data and assess the DPF.

engineOverview.title: Land Rover Discovery 4 306DT Engine: Your Complete 3.0 TDV6 Guide
paragraphs: The Land Rover Discovery 4 306DT engine is the 3.0-litre V6 twin-turbo diesel used across most Discovery 4 models, sold as the TDV6 and the more powerful SDV6. Strong but now high-mileage in many vehicles, it can suffer crankshaft failure, turbo faults, oil cooler leaks and DPF problems.

The 306DT was also fitted to Range Rover, Range Rover Sport and Jaguar models, with different outputs, ancillaries and wiring. We identify the correct Land Rover Discovery 4 3.0 TDV6 engine by checking your VIN, engine code and registration before supply.

Whether you need a targeted repair, an engine rebuild or a complete Land Rover Discovery 4 306DT engine replacement, our team assesses the vehicle and explains each option. Call us or send your registration for a written quote.
